_about: Public-domain Thomas Hopkins Gallaudet (1787-1851), Congregational minister and founder of the American Asylum for the deaf at Hartford, for the Word Hoard: Discourses on Various Points of Christian Faith and Practice, his sermons and addresses for the deaf and for missions, An Address on Female Education, The Youth's Book on Natural Theology, The Child's Book on the Soul, his histories of Jonah and Joseph for children, and The Child's Book of Bible Stories. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 113 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gallaudet-discourses: Discourses on various points of Christian faith and practice : most of which were delivered in the Chapel of the Oratoire, in Paris, in the Spring of M.DCCC.XVI (London : Printed by Ellerton and Henderson, for J. Hatchard, 1818)
gallaudet-seminary-plan: Plan of a seminary for the education of instructors of youth (Boston : Cummings, Hilliard and Co., 1825)
gallaudet-female-education: An address on female education (Hartford, H. & F. J. Huntington, 1828)
gallaudet-natural-theology: The youth's book on natural theology; illustrated in familiar dialogues, with numerous engravings (New York, The American Tract Society, 1832)
gallaudet-soul: The child's book on the soul (catalogued 1832)
gallaudet-jonah: The history of Jonah, for children and youth (Boston, Crocker & Brewster; New York, J. Leavitt, 1833)
gallaudet-joseph: The history of Joseph, for children and youth; designed also as an aid to familiar Biblical exposition in families, Sabbath schools, and Bible classes (New York, American Tract Society, 1834)
gallaudet-bible-stories: The child's book of Bible stories : with practical illustrations and remarks on the fall (New York : American Tract Society, 1834)

_excluded.gallaudet-other: His spelling books, picture-defining books and dictionary, the foreign-language translations, Clerc's address, and books by others he introduced, are left out
